verdict.rationale: Productboard supports validating feedback and only sending 'fully-validated features into delivery' (docs-14), and provides drivers like value/risk/impact/confidence/effort to structure prioritization decisions (docs-11), implying a review/approval gate before work begins. However, there is no explicit documentation of a formal approval/sign-off workflow, status gate, or PM approval step tied to task scope before development starts. missing for 10: explicit approval/sign-off workflow or status gate documentation, evidence of a scoped 'task' object with approval state, independent/hands-on confirmation of this gating behavior in practice.
